events.title: Monthly Club Meeting – “Wearables for Wildlife: Behind the Scenes with the Evolution of Wildlife Telemetry Technologies”
events.description: Club Meeting – North Museum of Nature and Science, 400 College Ave, Lancaster, PA 17603 Presented by Club President Andy McGann Andy McGann grew up birding in Southcentral Pennsylvania and his early experiences ultimately led to a career in the field of Movement Ecology. His time in academia, non-profits, consulting, and ultimately to a wildlife telemetry tech company spanned a timeframe that saw the science advance from analog radio telemetry to “smart devices” with GPS, accelerometers, and global Internet connectivity. In his career, Andy combined his experiences in ornithology with his love of technology and appreciation for geography in order to help wildlife researchers and organizations around the world obtain the scientific information needed to help conserve some of the rarest birds we have left. Andy will discuss the evolution of the technology, the current state-of-the-art, and paint a picture of where we are going.
